title: fundingDetails without its fundingType tag
description: fundingDetails is an empty object with no inner fundingType tag. Every branch of the fundingDetails oneOf requires the tag, so an untagged object matches zero branches and the oneOf fails; the binding allOf's grant branch fails on the same missing tag. The tag is what keeps the six all-optional detail shapes disjoint — without it an empty object would be ambiguous between five of them.
